feedback.problem:
If
    $Q=[\begin{aligned}-6 \\ 1 \\ 5\end{aligned}]$,
then find the transpose of $Q.$

  

| ${Q}^{T}=$ |  | {{field-1}} | {{field-2}} | {{field-3}} |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
feedback.worked_solution:
To find the transpose, we interchange the rows and columns:

$$
{Q}^{T}=[\begin{aligned}-6 & 1 & 5\end{aligned}]
$$
